text.en: Chain-of-Thought Prompting is row 59 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Chain-of-Thought Prompting 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 59 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates Chain-of-Thought Prompting with “Chain of Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Chain-of-Thought Prompting 与论文《Chain of Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Jason Wei, Denny Zhou”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 杰森·魏、丹尼·周；官方英文原文为“Jason Wei, Denny Zhou”。

text.en: Chain-of-Thought Prompting uses few-shot demonstrations with intermediate natural-language reasoning.
text.zh: Chain-of-Thought Prompting 采用包含自然语言中间推理的少样本示范。

text.en: Experts generally treat chain-of-thought prompting as a foundational interface for eliciting reasoning from large models, while cautioning that fluent rationales are not guaranteed to be faithful explanations. The method directly motivated self-consistency and many later reasoning-time strategies.
text.zh: 专家通常把思维链提示视为激发大模型推理能力的基础接口，同时提醒流畅的推理文字不一定忠实反映模型内部原因。该方法直接推动了自洽性以及许多后续推理时策略。
